Capability: Renders the model as an interactive 3D centerline view with instanced nodes, pipes, supports and components, a reference ground grid, scale bar and viewport status line.
Notes: Single 4.3k-line component that also hosts the authoring forms; the authoring panel can be portalled into a shell-owned container.

Capability: Switches pipe display between schematic lines and actual outside diameter, converting each pipe's diameter and wall to the model length unit before drawing and counting pipes that cannot be drawn.
Notes: Conversion goes through the external display quantity service; section-derived envelopes are checked for consistency.

Capability: Lets the user orient the camera with isometric, front and top presets, a view cube and orientation gizmo, orbit navigation, and fit to model, visible items or selection.
Notes: Fit commands are dispatched through a typed view-command channel owned by the parent shell.

Capability: Selects model entities by clicking in the canvas or activating a label, using analytic picking over the model index, with additive and toggle modifiers.
Notes: Picking never raycasts the display meshes; it resolves against typed primitives.

Capability: Box-selects entities by dragging a window or crossing rectangle, filtered to all, pipes, nodes, supports or components, and discards stale gestures.
Notes: Direction decides containment versus intersection.

Capability: Hides the selection, isolates it (dimming everything else) or shows all, deriving the effective hidden and dimmed sets and a hidden count without changing the model.
Notes: Presentation only; hide takes precedence over isolation. Visibility state is held by the workspace session outside this area.

Capability: Draws dimmed entities at reduced opacity by partitioning instanced meshes into prepared companion batches, so visibility toggles create no new GPU resources.
Notes: Render-side counterpart of isolation; a CI plan test names this source file.

Capability: Measures the distance between two picked nodes or along a picked pipe and shows the result in the chosen display units.
Notes: Canvas picks and keyboard label activation share one command path.

Capability: Presents selection and hover as screen-space halo outlines and point-primitive markers, and binds the applied selection to the rendered frame.
Notes: Display-only geometry excluded from picking; uses no stencil or post-processing.

Capability: Shades pipe figures with an untextured matte shader that darkens toward the silhouette and draws an optional outline edge within the same material.
Resolves canvas colours for light and dark themes from the product design-token file through a fixed role-to-token table, including gizmo contrast.
Notes: Reads apps/desktop/src/design/tokens.json at module load; no DOM style reads.

Capability: Fails the test run if any non-test viewport source holds a colour literal, or if stylesheet-drawn canvas furniture drifts from its design tokens.
Notes: Source-scanning guard implemented as unit tests.

Capability: Owns the WebGL renderer lifecycle: invalidation-driven frame scheduling, a resource ownership ledger with snapshots, context loss and restore handling, and full disposal.
Notes: Ownership snapshot is also consumed by e2e benchmark harnesses.

Capability: Rebases authored coordinates to a local render origin so large models stay float32-precise, and excludes geometry that cannot be represented.
Notes: Exclusion is reported in the viewport status line.

Capability: Toggles entity labels, the grid and authored-load display, showing a prioritized, bounded label set.
Notes: No test found that drives the loads toggle.

Capability: Draws authored force and moment loads as arrows at their node or pipe anchor along their global direction.
Notes: Only loads with a resolvable global direction are drawn.

Capability: Overlays the deformed shape from solved displacement results with a status, summary and boundary note, and reports blocked when mechanics are not solved.
Notes: Boundary text states no professional claim.

Capability: Provides a command bar to arm creation tools for node, pipe, support, component or load, with a selection readout and a hint for each armed tool.
Notes: Support and load tools only route the user to the inspector or load-case panel; creation for those happens outside this area.

Capability: Creates a node from typed coordinates or a click on the construction plane, checking the unit against the unit catalog, and submits it as a reviewable draft.
Drafts a straight pipe route from a picked start to an existing or new end node on an XY, XZ or YZ plane with axis constraints and a ghost preview, converting pointer points to model units.
Notes: Supports continuing the route from the last end after queueing; small pointer moves within a slop are treated as clicks.

Capability: Freezes a node or route draft for review, validates it on temporary state, and applies it only when the validation and apply results match the frozen submission.
Notes: Gate types are also consumed by workspace session state outside this area.

Capability: Builds, validates and queues a new bend, tee, reducer, valve, flange or expansion joint at a node with its per-kind geometry, stiffness and source references.
Notes: Shared by the viewport form and the property inspector; no unit test of its own.

Capability: Lists the editor intents queued from the viewport with their unit-validation status.
Reports viewport status such as 3D context loss, excluded geometry, unit catalog availability, invalid geometry and diameter conversion, and publishes viewport diagnostics to the workspace.
Notes: No test found that exercises the context-lost status.

Capability: Opens a searchable command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) listing toolkit capabilities by group plus shell view commands, and routes the chosen command.
Notes: Shows a roadmap of not-yet-available commands.

Capability: Declares the toolkit command vocabulary with status and route, and decides availability from selection type and count, undo/redo history and busy state.
Notes: Status values are self-declared; several entries are partial or gated and routes only focus existing panels.

Capability: Reviews queued operation batches: validate on temporary state, apply the whole batch atomically, block stale batches, show receipts and clear pending work.
Notes: No component-level unit test.

Capability: Queues removal of a selected material, section or component for review, where inbound references block deletion and nothing cascades.
Notes: Mounted from the property inspector.

Capability: Assigns a shared pipe section to the selected pipe or detaches it to local dimensions, queued for review.
Notes: Mounted from the property inspector.

Capability: Shows a typed mechanics result quantity in the chosen display units, or a fallback when the row is missing.
Notes: Used only by the diagnostics panel; tested indirectly through it.

Capability: Splits one pipe run at a fraction or translates, rotates or mirrors selected runs in copy or in-place mode with explicit new identities, queued as one batch.
Notes: Only the global coordinate system is accepted; attached items can block transforms at engine validation.

Capability: Provides shared batch-form parsing of required text and finite numbers, batch ID generation, and an async batch queue that cancels when the model, selection or draft changes.
Notes: Also used by boundary authoring outside this area; tested only indirectly.

Capability: Provides shared structured-form helpers: explicit quantity parsing with no blank-to-zero coercion, text and quantity fields, the reviewable edit-intent envelope, and a stale-safe queue hook.
Notes: The folder holds only the helper; the material, wind and support forms it serves live outside this area, though its tests exercise them.

Capability: Produces the selected entity's display label and typed property rows for project, material, section, node, pipe, support, component, load and combination.
Notes: Missing values show as TBD; quantities keep their source units.

Capability: Summarizes design-workspace state (knowledge records, runs, comparisons, queued operations, routing, units and data boundary) without applying anything.
Notes: Part of its evidence block is fixed constants rather than computed from current state.

Capability: Exports the design-workspace composition as a local JSON download with unit-policy evidence and no-mutation and professional-boundary flags.
Notes: Payload embeds hard-coded planning identifiers and repository paths; export goes through a controlled export link outside this area.

Capability: Lets the user choose Entered, SI or US display units for all readouts, while editing stays in entered units.
Notes: Compact variant is mounted in the shell toolbar.

Capability: Converts displayed quantities through the external unit engine in batched, deduplicated requests, drops late responses and falls back to entered values with a notice.
Notes: No arithmetic is done here; conversion is delegated to the display quantity service.

Capability: Maps each physical dimension to its SI and US display unit symbols, with explicit gaps where no US symbol is defined.
Notes: Also used by table quantity sorting outside this area.
